approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 65 Chapter 628
 
      MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 8939-B, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT to amend the labor law, in relation to preventing displace-
        ment of call center workers who provide call center services for
        the government in certain circumstances"
 
    APPROVED
 
  This bill seeks to protect workers who provide  call  center  services
under  a contract between the State and their employer from displacement
in the event that the State selects another contractor to  perform  that
work through the State procurement process.
 
  Creating  jobs  and  protecting hard-working New Yorkers is a priority
for me, and I fully support the  goals  of  this  legislation.  However,
changes  are  necessary  to  make  such  hiring  an elective process and
utilize a best practices model for incoming  call  services  contractors
with the State to hire employees of the prior contracted entity for call
services.
 
  I  am  pleased  to  have  reached an agreement with the Legislature to
enact these changes. On the basis of this agreement,  I  am  pleased  to
sign this bill.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______

summary: Prevents the displacement of call center workers who provide call center services for the government in certain circumstances; provides protections for call center workers when contracts with call center contractors are terminated; requires new call center contractors to hire existing call center workers; protects collective bargaining agreements.
title: Prevents the displacement of call center workers who provide call center services for the government in certain circumstances
